## Triage: first grade, `bug` · `priority:p3` · `domain:cli` · `area:devpath` · `pm:queue`. Direction: the producer conforms, so the build attaches flat `src/docs` to the package that owns the manifest

Triage seat (objectstack-wide, seat post #6015) · `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U` · 2026-10-08T07:07Z. ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch.

Triage: lands in `packages/cli/src/utils/collect-docs*` ⇒ `domain:cli`; rationale: under the 2026-09-22 ADR-0130 addendum, a multi-package artifact carries its metadata once, in `packages[]`. The collector is the side that still writes a top-level `docs[]`.

- **Why p3:** behaviour is correct (5 docs served, owner right). What is wrong is one boot WARN whose remedy cannot be followed in the ADR-0130 layout.
- **Why not silence the sweep:** `packages/metadata/src/plugin.ts`'s residual warning is right about everything else it catches. A carve-out there for one producer's shape is a consumer-side exception.
- **Pins:** the two-package build puts the flat docs on the app package's body, and the boot logs no residual for them. Controls: the single-package shape is unchanged; `src/service/docs` still lands on the service body.

Claim: PM loop round 1
Session: `session_01BmsuLyUeuG5CNpZFMH1jzS`
Account: `os-elon-musk` (the seat's linked user as `GET /user` answers it; always the card's assignee)
Branch: `claude/issue-22190-flat-docs-owner-package`
Worktree: `objectstack-issue-22190`
Domain: `domain:cli`
Seat: `domain:cli#1`
File surface: `packages/cli/src/utils/collect-docs.ts` (`collectDocsFromSrc` and the package-docs attachment), `packages/cli/src/commands/compile.ts` (where the flat `docs` are written, about `:931`-`:1000`), new or extended tests beside them under `packages/cli/src/utils/` or `packages/cli/test/`, and `.changeset/22190-*.md` (`@objectstack/cli` patch). ⛔ Not `packages/metadata/src/plugin.ts` (the residual sweep stays as it is, per triage). Stop on breach; explain in the report.
Container & model: `M`, `mode:subagent`, `model: default (opus)`. `dispatch-gates --tier` prints "no path-derived mandate"; the owner of the flat directory is a design judgment, so this is not a mechanical card.
Clause-②: no
Responsibility: `packages/cli/src/utils/collect-docs.ts` with `compile.ts`, this lane's producer, writes flat docs to the top level of a multi-package artifact | none: the metadata plugin's residual sweep is right to warn, and triage ruled out a carve-out there | every boot of a multi-package artifact that ships flat `src/docs` reaches it; it is used today (a downstream app measures it on every boot)
Thread-read: 6054545749
Serial constraints cleared: no open PR touches `collect-docs.ts` or `compile.ts` (REST file lists of all 14 open PRs, read in this round). PR #22381 edits `packages/cli/src/utils/stack-collections.ts` and `serve.ts`, which this card does not write. Lane sibling in flight: #22310 (`packages/runtime/src/domains/automation.ts`), disjoint.

## ACCEPT: PR #22403 (head `027bc7fa4`)

<sub>`domain:cli` seat (#6024) · `session_01BmsuLyUeuG5CNpZFMH1jzS` · 2026-10-09T03:05Z. Reviewed against GitHub, not against the report.</sub>

- **PR shape:** draft, base `main`; the first line is `Fixes #22190`, the only closing keyword in the body, and the body carries a line-initial `Clause-②: no`. Six files, `+556 / -27`, all inside the claim's surface: `compile.ts`, `collect-docs.ts`, a new `collect-docs.flat-docs-owner.test.ts`, and two existing `packages/cli/test` pins. The changeset is `.changeset/22190-flat-docs-owner-package.md` (`@objectstack/cli` patch). No governed path; `packages/metadata` and `serve.ts` are untouched.
- **Diff read:**
  - `placeCollectedDocs` is now the one decision of where both doc sets land.
  - `flatDocsOwner` answers the single `packages[]` entry whose id equals `manifest.id`, read through `docsPackageRefs`, and nobody otherwise. ⛔ No guess.
  - The flat set is appended after the owner's own directory docs through `attachPackageDocs` (its `claimedDocs` identity dedupe is unchanged). Inline top-level docs never move.
  - With no `packages[]`, the very `docs` array and `packages` value come back, so a single-package artifact is byte-identical (sha256 `710ab6c6` on both base and head, per the report).
- **Triage direction met:** the producer conforms and the residual sweep is untouched. The two-package build puts the flat docs on the app body. The boot WARN count is 1 at base and 0 on head, through the real `MetadataPlugin` door, with a lit control that draws exactly one warning. `src/service/docs` stays on the service body.
- **A behaviour change the changeset states, accepted:** these docs now ride the owning package's installed record and its lock (`full`, resettable), as a single-package artifact's flat docs and any `src/PKG/docs` doc already do. Before, they were a residual registered outside any package record.
- **Spot-checked:** `@objectstack/metadata` is a declared dependency of `@objectstack/cli`, so the door test's import is legitimate. The ablation (`owners.length === 1` broken) fails 5 of 15 unit cases (every placement and door case) and the owned-placement e2e case; every control stays green.
- **Gates:** the dev's union at `027bc7fa4` (the PR's current head) was 65 of 65 exit 0, `--ran` reconciled with 0 unrun, and the full `pnpm lint` exited 0. **CI:** in progress at this read, with no failure. Landing waits for every check to be green.
- **The dev's open question, answered here** (an in-seat call under SKILL.md's non-escalation class; the maintainer's veto window applies): **A, keep the unmatched case as pinned.** When no entry carries `manifest.id`, or two do, the flat docs stay on the top level and the residual warning stays true.
  - `composeStacks(…, { manifest: 'preserve' })` always yields the match, and no in-repo or reported producer writes the unmatched shape (zero pull).
  - B would add a new build diagnostic, and a new gate defaults to no unless the maintainer names it.
  - C guesses an owner, the silent misattribution the metadata door refuses to make.
- **Out of scope:**
  - `filed #22405`: the config-boot twin. `os serve objectstack.config.ts --dev` on a two-package project serves none of its flat docs and warns nothing (measured). Its fix reuses `placeCollectedDocs` in `serve.ts` after PR #22381 releases that file.
  - `Acceptance notes`: the `docsArtifact` docblock in `packages/metadata/src/plugin-artifact-packages-attribution.test.ts` (`domain:engine`'s; carrier: the next PR to touch it).
  - `Acceptance notes`: the `normalized-call-sites.test.ts` row's `why` (carrier: #22405's fix).
